beyond_dusky_skies: Cyril "Mole" Skies signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F17 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Arno Toastyy and Cyril "Mole" Skies carried a kettle through three narrow traverses without spilling a drop. Applause at the destination caused the accident.

A man asked Cyril "Mole" Skies to describe Northwick without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Cyril "Mole" Skies watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony spotted Henrik Hunted of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Drowned Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Cyril "Mole" Skies traded a book with the last pages torn out for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.

Cyril "Mole" Skies fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin "Shadow" Danny, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Cyril "Mole" Skies wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dawn watch. Cyril "Mole" Skies put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Marek Red, gravely wounded.
Cyril "Mole" Skies traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
A clear shot from R-F17. Cyril "Mole" Skies gravely wounded Gideon "Whistle" Vylet and slid back down below the parapet.
Cyril "Mole" Skies fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Rafael "Hollow" Red, now badly wounded.

Cyril "Mole" Skies fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Tobias Skylerb was gravely wounded. Machine-gun fire swept R-F17. Cyril "Mole" Skies took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Zeno Kallenfultz of the Concord (@kallenfultz). The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Cyril "Mole" Skies did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
bosupernova: On the way to T-F12, Edmund Bosupernova tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Edmund Bosupernova listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
casualkriegsman: Teodor Casualkriegs arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Teodor Casualkriegs could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Teodor Casualkriegs. Teodor Casualkriegs read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
dwnlo_music: Konrad Music, a printer's apprentice from Dunmarrow, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in T-F9. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Konrad Music watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
franek.szymanski.376: Felix Szymanski arrived at S-F7 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor Jackmdunn kept the tin.
Felix Szymanski caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.

Felix Szymanski's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Felix Szymanski watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Felix Szymanski fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Felix "Tin" Singh, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F7. Felix Szymanski was the only one they could still help, and only just. A shell landed square in the trench at S-F7. Felix Szymanski was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.

Isidor "Brick" Szymanski arrived carrying the family name of Felix Szymanski. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Isidor "Brick" Szymanski transferred to the machine gunners. The men in S-F7 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Isidor "Brick" Szymanski at S-F7, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. Isidor "Brick" Szymanski read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Isidor "Brick" Szymanski during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

There was no bed for Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. Isidor "Brick" Szymanski read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Isidor "Brick" Szymanski died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The papers connected Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski to Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. The men took longer to learn Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski's own habits, but they made the effort.
Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

At the Sunken Road, Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski of the Hegemony and Gustav "Spark" Echoss of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning. Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski became a machine gunner today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F7. Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Benedikt Manningwam of the Concord (@manningwam).
Edmund Szymanski put a stub of a pencil beside the bunk. Someone who had known Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski helped clear the shelf without saying why.
javimty97: Nobody asked Emil "Mud" Javimty why he came. Nobody in R-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Emil "Mud" Javimty is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Emil "Mud" Javimty finished a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

Emil "Mud" Javimty lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Emil "Mud" Javimty wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Emil "Mud" Javimty wrote a letter for Anselm "Parson" Rock's mother, because Parson could not find the words. Parson signed it.

Emil "Mud" Javimty's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-F9 is closed now. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Emil "Mud" Javimty stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A second spoon disappeared. Emil "Mud" Javimty searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty thought about a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F9 in the middle of the night. Emil "Mud" Javimty met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Teodor "Doc" Rley of the Hegemony (@ma.rley5115).
The House of Javimty sent Severin "Owl" Javimty after Emil "Mud" Javimty. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
jnk_0__: Jakub Jnk reported to S-C9 with a child's drawing of a horse sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Jakub Jnk listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
logan12835: The old hands of S-C16 have been here since Day 1. Hugo "Shadow" Logan has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Hugo "Shadow" Logan wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
m.np01: By the time Bastian Mnp reached R-R9, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. The new duty roster listed Bastian Mnp as a chaplain. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian Mnp folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. A letter from home found Bastian Mnp before the night shift. Bastian Mnp folded it small and kept it close.
rykerfallion: Oskar Rykerfallion signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-R16 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. After what happened at the Ossuary Wood, Oskar Rykerfallion asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.

In the dark of the Concord trench Oskar Rykerfallion hit Ulrich "Bones" Cocac with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@noel_cocac) A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Oskar Rykerfallion across the shin at S-R16. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc of the Concord (@kcharlesc2027). Oskar Rykerfallion walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home found Oskar Rykerfallion before the night shift. Oskar Rykerfallion folded it small and kept it close.
somehowballin: After 5 days of war, S-S6 had a place for everything. On Day 6, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Lucien Somehowballi.
On a quiet night Lucien Somehowballi (Hegemony) and Zeno "Shadow" Maximus (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Lucien Somehowballi won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in S-S6. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Lucien Somehowballi carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters.
A crow sat on the parapet above Lucien Somehowballi all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Lucien Somehowballi helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
thembamstel: Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel reported to T-F12 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel was on watch at T-F12 when the night raid hit. The men found Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Severin Lolmujahid of the Concord (@lolmujahid_).
The papers say Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel's eyes. Nobody in T-F12 argues.
